A horse of Việt Nam (ngựa): a small horse, about 1.35 m at the withers, brown with a dark mane.
The horses of the north of Việt Nam are small: about 1.2 to 1.4 m at the withers. The template is a horse.
The lengths of the fur (fur): a guess from photos of the animal, not a measurement. The mane and the tail of the template are meshes of hair (the role mane); their fur is the strands on them.
